title: Resurrecting Atlantis

poet_identity.adult: The same Black male Poet throughout: deep dark-brown skin, low faded haircut, neat full beard and moustache.
poet_identity.01_03: Plain black T-shirt, dark trousers, plain dark sneakers; no sunglasses.
poet_identity.04_14: Black tracksuit with thin red piping, black Chelsea boots; sunglasses are a separate component.
poet_identity.young: Young Poet is the same character as a Black boy.
poet_identity.double_and_soul: The double and soul keep the Poet identity; they are instances or special treatments of him.
poet_identity.other_roles: Women and other men are separately labeled supporting roles, never substitutes for the Poet.

limits: Labeled raster concept/production-reference sheets with visually separated components, not individual transparent PNG exports.
Artwork was visually checked for identity, component classes and separation. Print scale, crop boundaries and exact pivot coordinates are not calibrated.
Main-pose and overview figures demonstrate assembly; use the detached working parts for construction.
Cut or mask parts, align the same-view pivots, set layer order and test motion before production.
Effects described as coded in the treatment are represented by visual elements/instructions; no animation engine or coded effect is implemented in these packs.

qa_notes: All nine canonical names are now present: AMOS, IDA, OTIS, RUTH, MAE, ELI, CORA, SOL, JUNE. The registered KIN vector supplement supplies exact placement and connectivity.
Use05.props.star-names orb as canonical head; beacon is now independent.
Floor center repaired to solid walkable stone; only narrow radial slots cut through. Three rim rings, dish, plinth and light backing independent.
Ten detached cards; unwanted baked wall lamp removed. Teal/pink/rust container identity shared with07.
Baked serving ledge and awning removed from front; independent counter and roof retained. Door and service apertures empty.
Empty gateway and pool apertures; admission booth reused from root06.props.coin-booth.
All23 glazing units labelled L01–L08,C01–C07,R01–R08. Six circle-plus-rectangle units contain two detached subpieces each: L02,L07,C02,C06,R02,R07.
Use suffix .round for the upper circular glass and .lower for the lower rectangular glass in those six units. There are29 loose glazing pieces, three facades, floor and sky:34 cut pieces.
Waterline corrected to a continuous movable blue water-edge strip; city, terraces, vines, sky and water remain separate.
Sixteen independent buildings CITY01–16; CITY01 capital dome, CITY02–03 emerging spires. No actors or water attached.
Continuous yellow-brick road surface, not floating steps; city tips and comets supplied separately.
Six gold trunks and six crystal canopies separated; floor repaired to blank black without reflected light streaks.
Facade, doors, glazing, light string and street floor separated. Permanent balcony/pipe details are part of the facade cards.

assembly_notes: Working body parts are separate: waist-length armless torso, independent hip connector/rear seat, single upper/lower limbs, hands and feet. Main-pose pages and marked proof bands are assembly references.

Master overview is identity reference only. Corrected separated core and action cards govern assembly. Painted heads in legacy action sheets are expression references; use blank heads and separate features from the core.
Core anchor pattern and the root assembly guide govern pivot placement. Generic prop samples on action pages are references; source-specific root prop sheets are authoritative.

view_limits: Bodies supply three torso views and one set of flat single-segment limb paint cards; they are reusable design components, not every perspective of every joint.
Eight background head variants have front/back working plates only; full assembled rear-threequarter crowd references are separate.
Some torso cards have shoulder marks without painted N/W marks; neck/waist placement must be registered using the geometric guide.
Working shoes have one ankle attachment marker each. Traveler bag/strap labels reuse numeric20/21 from shoes; named part IDs disambiguate.
Props shown in pose proofs are cues; independent lantern, guitar, candle and soul-light assets are in root props/FX.
information.mechanical_status: Every torso, hip connector, rear seat, lower garment panel and limb segment is independent. All raster sheets still require crop/scale/pivot registration.
information.protagonist_continuity: No Atlantis elder or traveler is the established Black male POET. Legacy costume key poet_elder_coat maps only to ELDER_1.

information.scope: All twelve source scenery/hero kits mapped to ten independent-parts sheets and explicit shared props/FX
assembly_notes: CITY01–16 define the reusable skyline. Use only CITY01–03 tips initially, then uncover the whole skyline by lowering the water-edge strip.
The road is a continuous paved surface. Actor footsteps and moving lantern illumination are independent.
Use the root admission-booth frame, panes and coin tray within the empty gate surround.
Pair the six hall trunks with corresponding canopies at three depths. Make floor reflections from final assembled geometry as separate layers.
The container house is the same place used in07. The empty Sunken Forum is reused in10.
Plaza glazing labels identify window units; six units contain separate round and rectangular subpieces as described in metadata.
limitations: Generated raster art is visually reviewed, not pixel-registered rig artwork.
Architecture panels retain permanent decorative detail; all specified moving doors, panes, lighting strings and scenery layers are detached.
Scale, hinge registration, final light and exact reflections are established during assembly.

information.scope: Reviewed props, painted FX and selected character special components
